explication: Gentelella v4 is a vanilla-JavaScript admin dashboard template: users open one of its production HTML pages and interact with dashboard, business-app, and UI-demo surfaces. The runtime entry mounts the shared shell and initializes dashboard features, with page-specific modules loaded where needed. The README documents broader page and PWA capabilities; some page-to-module wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so uncertain relationships are omitted. The sample inbox adapter is included, but no persistent application database is evidenced.
